answer_3.quote: To further assess the quality of the dataset, we used GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet to annotate the relevance of other 650 query-document pairs.

answer_4.quote: Three independent native Spanish speakers hired via Prolific (prolific.com) rated the same 100 random samples for 13.60 USD/hr.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were instructed to consider that the query may only make sense in the context of the user's country, which may not be explicitly stated.
